milestones.title: Research environment setup
milestones.description: WSL2 Ubuntu, Python 3.12, CUDA-enabled PyTorch and the research dependency stack.

milestones.title: Semantic embedding proof of concept
milestones.description: Frozen MiniLM embeddings validated on synthetic descriptions.

milestones.title: Autoencoder proof of concept
milestones.description: 384-128-32-128-384 autoencoder trained on synthetic benign descriptions.

milestones.title: Dataset acquisition
milestones.description: CICAPT-IIoT provenance logs and supplementary material acquired.

milestones.title: Dataset inspection
milestones.description: Schema, label distribution, missing values and file integrity inspected.

milestones.title: Provenance graph analysis
milestones.description: Nodes, edges and unresolved references checked for both collection phases.

milestones.title: Ground-truth analysis
milestones.description: Original malicious edges and connected-node contextual indicators analysed separately.

milestones.title: V1 and V2 verbalisation
milestones.description: Deterministic natural-language event descriptions implemented and validated.

milestones.title: Chronological dataset splitting
milestones.description: Leakage-aware chronological train, validation, benign-test and attack-test partitions.

milestones.title: Embedding generation
milestones.description: Frozen MiniLM embeddings generated for all event partitions.

milestones.title: Initial autoencoder training
milestones.description: E2-A benign-trained frequency-preserving autoencoder.

milestones.title: Baseline comparisons
milestones.description: B1 exact novelty, B2 TF-IDF/Isolation Forest, B3 PCA and B4 embedding/Isolation Forest.

milestones.title: Threshold sensitivity
milestones.description: Validation-derived percentile sweep for E2 configurations.

milestones.title: Frequency-balanced training
milestones.description: E2-B unique-description and E2-C frequency-weighted variants.

milestones.title: Approximately matched-update training
milestones.description: E2-D unique-description training matched to the original optimiser-update budget.

milestones.title: Alert prioritisation
milestones.description: Tie-aware analyst alert-budget analysis for E2-A to E2-D.

milestones.title: Provenance representation ablation
milestones.description: E5-A operation-only, E5-B entity-enriched and E5-C full-provenance comparison.

milestones.title: E7 multiple-seed reproducibility
milestones.description: Repeat selected experiments with seeds 42, 123 and 456; report mean, standard deviation and individual outcomes.

milestones.title: B6 semantic nearest-neighbour baseline
milestones.description: Compare cosine nearest-neighbour distance with the autoencoder.

milestones.title: E1 V1 versus V2 verbalisation comparison
milestones.description: Controlled comparison of earlier and current verbalisations.

milestones.title: E3 chunk-aware embeddings
milestones.description: Reduce information loss for descriptions exceeding the encoder token limit.

milestones.title: E4 MPNet encoder comparison
milestones.description: Compare a larger encoder under a matched configuration.

milestones.title: E6 temporal and provenance event correlation
milestones.description: Move from independent event scoring toward correlated sequences and incident reconstruction.

milestones.title: Independent attack-scenario validation
milestones.description: Evaluate a frozen configuration on an independent scenario or host.

milestones.title: M1 human-reviewed mitigation framework
milestones.description: Evidence-grounded mitigation recommendations requiring analyst approval.

milestones.title: D1 interactive research demonstration platform
milestones.description: Read-only dashboard over real research artifacts. Implementation is not a validated research outcome.

milestones.title: Dissertation writing and final evaluation
milestones.description: Final synthesis, limitations, independent evaluation and dissertation submission.
